output.reason: The change text says v1.19.0 ended patch support for the 1.18 line and every earlier line. This item, though, asserts end-of-life for Kyverno v1.13.0 only. The release-management document [ev-a93d8c7284ca] is the source cited for this policy, but its excerpt is truncated. The proposed range <1.19.0 would also flag environments on 1.12 or 1.14–1.18, which are not the subject of this item, so it is broader than the subject. Exposure should be limited to environments running the 1.13 line.

correction.statement: Kyverno v1.13.0 (the 1.13 line) has been end-of-life since v1.19.0 (2026-08). Environments running a 1.13.x release get no further releases, bug fixes or security fixes and should plan a migration.
